items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: I never knew anything about him. I never did talk to Euless Jean either.

ctx.x: And I'm born in October. Yeah.

Yeah, we're the same age. Same age. You know, if he took lessons from anybody? Yeah, he took lessons from his uncle, Nelson Jean. Oh, yeah, I never knew anything about him. I never did talk to Euless Jean either. No. And he may get down here though sometime, I guess you say he comes down here to work anyway. Yeah, if I ever see him, I'll have him to come see him. If he's ever here at night, tell him to come by the hall here. I sure will. A lot of people will be glad to see him, I know.
Yeah, I'm going to pass the word around to his brother when I see him.
